title: Status Saver: Save & Share
summary: Save WhatsApp & Business statuses offline. Fast photo & video downloader.
description:
Never Miss a WhatsApp Status Again!

Tired of WhatsApp statuses vanishing after 24 hours? Status Saver for WhatsApp is your simple, trustworthy solution. Easily view, save, and share photos and videos from WhatsApp and WhatsApp Business before they disappear forever. No more FOMO on those memorable moments shared by friends and family!

Why Choose Status Saver?

One-Tap Saves: Instantly save status images and videos with a single tap. No complicated steps—just pure simplicity.

Full-Screen Preview: Swipe through statuses in beautiful full-screen mode. Zoom, admire, and decide what to keep.

Batch Saving: Select multiple statuses at once and save them all in one go. Perfect for when your contacts flood you with great content.

Direct Sharing: Saved statuses ready to share to any app—Instagram, Telegram, or anywhere else.

 Perfect for WhatsApp Users

Works seamlessly with both WhatsApp and WhatsApp Business. Access statuses directly from your device's gallery—no extra permissions needed beyond standard storage access.

Completely offline—no internet required, ensuring your privacy stays intact. All saves happen locally on your device; nothing leaves your phone.

 Modern, User-Friendly Design

Dark Mode, Light Mode & Material You: Matches your system theme for a native Android feel.

Clean Interface: No ads, no clutter. Just a friendly app focused on what you need.

Fast & Lightweight: Optimized for all Android devices, from budget phones to flagships.

How It Works (Super Simple!)

Open WhatsApp and view a status.

Go to your device's gallery or file manager—statuses appear in a dedicated folder.

Open Status Saver, preview in full screen, tap to save.

Share or keep privately. Done!

Real User Stories

"Finally, I can save my bestie's travel videos before they vanish!" – Sarah K.

"Batch save is a game-changer for group chats." – Mike T.

"Ad-free and private—exactly what I wanted." – Anonymous

Key Benefits

 Save Memories Effortlessly: Capture photos and videos forever.
 Privacy First: Local processing, no data collection or uploads.
Free Forever: No subscriptions, no in-app purchases.
Trusted & Safe: Follows Google Play policies, regular updates for latest WhatsApp versions.

Supports Latest WhatsApp Updates

Always compatible with the newest WhatsApp features. We've got you covered as WhatsApp evolves.

Pro Tips for Best Experience

Enable storage permissions for seamless access.

Use dark mode at night for eye comfort.

Share saved statuses to spread the joy!

Ready to stop losing statuses?

Download Status Saver for WhatsApp now and keep every moment.
